note: Baseline allowlist is EMPTY by design: the bundled families ship disabled (see silent-success-rules.json) and a fresh install scans clean. A CONSUMER's allowlist entries belong in the consumer's project-root .guardrails/ overlay (same merge contract as the prevention rules) — never here. The 1,726 gamerepo01 entries that shipped here until 2026-09-19 were decontaminated (QA H3).

entry_shape.file: repo-relative path of the file containing the marker
entry_shape.marker: substring of the offending line that identifies it
entry_shape.reason: why it is tolerated for now
